summary: Completed frontend-only testing of AI Assistant settings page (/settings/ai) with mocked APIs. All core functionality verified: State A (not connected), drawer with 3 steps, device code flow, polling mechanism, State B (connected), manage account, model selection, reconnect, disconnect, and navigation. Found one minor UX issue with drawer not auto-closing after polling.

ui_bugs.issue: Drawer does not auto-close after successful polling. When polling completes and status becomes 'connected', the drawer should close automatically (line 122: setOpen(false)) but remains open. Connected card is rendered behind the drawer but not visible.
ui_bugs.workaround: User can see manage account sheet which confirms connection, but the visual transition is broken

ui_bugs.issue: Cancel button (ai-signin-cancel) calls cancelSignIn() which resets session state but doesn't close the drawer. User must click 'Not now' to close the drawer after canceling. This creates a confusing UX where the drawer shows the initial 'Sign in with ChatGPT' state after cancel.
ui_bugs.suggestion: cancelSignIn() should either close the drawer or the Cancel button should call close() directly

passed_tests: State A: 'Not connected' status displays correctly with ChatGPT row
Drawer opens with correct content: 3 steps, 'Sign in with ChatGPT' button, 'Not now' button, plan note
Device code flow: POST /api/ai/chatgpt/start returns session_id, user_code 'DD1L-JYRDD', verify_url with target='_blank'
Waiting indicator and Cancel button visible during sign-in
Polling mechanism: 3 polls executed (pending, pending, connected) with 5s interval
State B: Connected state achieved (verified via manage account sheet)
Connected badge, 'Connected' pill, and manage account row present
Manage account sheet: displays model 'gpt-5.4-mini', reconnect, open ChatGPT options
Model selection: 2 options (gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4-mini), PUT /api/ai/links/chatgpt triggered on selection
Reconnect flow: opens drawer directly in device code state
Disconnect flow: dialog appears, DELETE /api/ai/links/chatgpt called, returns to State A
No console errors or React warnings detected
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix drawer auto-close after polling: ensure setOpen(false) is called when polling status becomes 'connected' (line 122 in AiAssistant.jsx). The drawer should close automatically to reveal the connected card. Currently, the connected card is rendered but hidden behind the drawer.
